### Headline summary
- Microsoft released a record number of security updates while confirming active exploitation of an Outlook zero-day. ([Cisco Talos Blog](https://blog.talosintelligence.com/microsoft-patch-tuesday-for-november-2026/), [CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4247015/november-2026-patch-tuesday-63-critical-microsoft-fixes-plus-an-outlook-zero-day-that-allows-theft-of-hashed-credentials.html), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/outlook-0-day-vulnerability/), [SOC Prime Blog](https://socprime.com/blog/cve-2026-124194-microsoft-outlook-zero-day-exploited-to-steal-ntlm-hashes/))
- N-able issued emergency hotfixes and temporarily shut down its N-central service following the disclosure of 33 alleged zero-day vulnerabilities. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/n-able-releases-security-hotfixes-for-zero-day-vulnerabilities/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/n-able-n-central-security-vulnerabilities/))
- CISA flagged flaws in Cisco BroadWorks as actively exploited, while researchers disclosed the use of AI agents to steal AWS credentials. ([SANS Internet Storm Center](https://isc.sans.edu/diary/rss/33510), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisco-broadworks-and-openwave-flaws.html), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hackers-use-antifox-ai-agents-in-aws-credential-theft-attacks/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/antifox-ai-pentesting-platform-linked.html))

### Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday
Microsoft released its November 2026 security updates, addressing a record number of vulnerabilities across its products. ([Cisco Talos Blog](https://blog.talosintelligence.com/microsoft-patch-tuesday-for-november-2026/), [CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4247015/november-2026-patch-tuesday-63-critical-microsoft-fixes-plus-an-outlook-zero-day-that-allows-theft-of-hashed-credentials.html), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/microsoft-patches-1259-flaws-including.html), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/202839/hacking/microsoft-november-patch-tuesday-one-exploited-outlook-bug-and-30-wormable-flaws.html))

### N-able releases hotfixes for N-central vulnerabilities
N-able released emergency hotfixes for its N-central platform after the public disclosure of 33 alleged zero-day vulnerabilities, which also led to a temporary worldwide shutdown of the service. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/n-able-releases-security-hotfixes-for-zero-day-vulnerabilities/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/n-able-n-central-security-vulnerabilities/), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/n-able-n-central-able2shell-0day/), [Dark Reading](https://www.darkreading.com/endpoint-security/n-able-n-central-offline-33-flaws))

### Microsoft Outlook Zero-Day Exploitation
Microsoft confirmed that hackers are actively exploiting a zero-day vulnerability in Outlook to steal Windows NTLM authentication hashes. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/outlook-0-day-vulnerability/), [SOC Prime Blog](https://socprime.com/blog/cve-2026-124194-microsoft-outlook-zero-day-exploited-to-steal-ntlm-hashes/))

### CISA Advisory on Cisco BroadWorks
CISA flagged flaws in Cisco BroadWorks as being actively exploited, a development highlighted in the ISC Stormcast for November 11. ([SANS Internet Storm Center](https://isc.sans.edu/diary/rss/33510), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisco-broadworks-and-openwave-flaws.html), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/threat-actors-exploit-openwave-cisco-broadworks-vulnerabilities/), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-flags-cisco-broadworks-flaw-as-actively-exploited-in-attacks/))

### OpenSSH authentication flaw exploited to bypass logins
Hackers are exploiting a decade-old OpenSSH vulnerability to bypass Linux logins and install backdoors, a flaw that has been confirmed by CISA and discussed in security media. ([Security Now (YouTube Playlist)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HWYxNVugkCA), [HackRead](https://hackread.com/hackers-exploit-old-openssh-bypass-linux-logins/))

### Maersk confirms data breach by WhiteArmor ransomware
Maersk announced that a threat actor gained unauthorized access to a legacy system, while the WhiteArmor group claimed to have stolen 100GB of data and demanded a $5 million ransom. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/maersk-confirms-data-breach-as-whitearmor-ransomware-demands-5-million/), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/202869/data-breach/whitearmor-demands-5-million-from-maersk-claims-theft-of-100gb-of-data.html))

### AntiFox AI agents used in AWS credential theft
Cybersecurity researchers disclosed that attackers used the open-source AntiFox agentic pentesting platform to target IIS servers and steal AWS production credentials and secrets. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hackers-use-antifox-ai-agents-in-aws-credential-theft-attacks/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/antifox-ai-pentesting-platform-linked.html), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/202880/hacking/ai-pentest-tool-antifox-abused-to-steal-aws-credentials.html))

### Git patches six security vulnerabilities
The Git project released security updates addressing six vulnerabilities, including a critical flaw that allows attackers to execute malicious code during recursive repository clones. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/git-fixes-security-vulnerabilities/), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/11/git-project-security-updates/))
